title: Targeting a Leukemia-Relevant Protein-Protein Interface: N-Aryl Anthranilic Acids as Disruptors of the c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX Interaction.
authors: Alfassam, Haifa E; Kamel, Emadeldin M; Othman, Sarah I; Alharbi, Hanan M; Rudayni, Hassan A; Allam, Ahmed A; Lamsabhi, Al Mokhtar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过对接、MD和MM/PBSA等计算手段筛选小分子破坏剂靶向c-Myb-KIX蛋白-蛋白界面，虽涉及转录因子相关复合物，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: The interaction between c-Myb and the CBP/p300 KIX domain is a key transcriptional event in acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and represents an attractive target for small-molecule intervention. In this study, we applied an integrated computational-experimental strategy to identify new N-aryl anthranilic acid disruptors of the c-Myb-KIX protein-protein interaction. A scaffold-focused library of 3656 N-aryl anthranilic acid derivatives was filtered, docked to the c-Myb-binding groove of KIX (PDB 2AGH), and the top hits were further evaluated by MD simulations, MM/PBSA, FEL, and ADMET analyses. This workflow prioritized four hits (C1-C4) for experimental testing. Computational analyses showed that all four compounds remained bound within the alpha1/alpha3 Myb-facing groove, but differed markedly in their predicted effects on the c-Myb-KIX interface. Among them, C3 emerged as the strongest predicted disruptor, whereas C1 was predicted to stabilize the complex. The DeltaDeltaGPPI analysis further showed that C3 produced the largest destabilizing effect on the c-Myb-KIX interface (+4.57 kcal/mol), followed by C2 (+2.30 kcal/mol) and C4 (+1.40 kcal/mol), whereas C1 stabilized the complex (-6.47 kcal/mol). These predictions were validated by microscale thermophoresis (MST). The binary c-Myb-KIX interaction showed an apparent K(d) of 26.71 +/- 0.54 muM, and the compounds inhibited complex formation with IC(50) values of 99.6 +/- 20.5 muM (C1), 54.7 +/- 22.1 muM (C2), 16.5 +/- 0.8 muM (C3), and 27.2 +/- 2.7 muM (C4). Notably, C3 outperformed the reference inhibitor Naphthol AS-E phosphate (28.8 +/- 3.1 muM). Overall, these findings identify C3 as a promising lead and establish N-aryl anthranilic acids as a tractable scaffold for targeting the c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX interaction.
abstract_zh: c-Myb与CBP/p300 KIX结构域之间的相互作用是急性髓系白血病（AML）中的一个关键转录事件，并代表了小分子干预的一个有吸引力的靶点。在本研究中，我们应用了一种集成的计算-实验策略，以识别新的N-芳基邻氨基苯甲酸类c-Myb-KIX蛋白-蛋白相互作用破坏剂。一个包含3656种N-芳基邻氨基苯甲酸衍生物的骨架聚焦文库被筛选，并对接至KIX的c-Myb结合沟槽（PDB 2AGH），随后对排名靠前的命中化合物进行了分子动力学（MD）模拟、MM/PBSA、自由能景观（FEL）和ADMET分析评估。该工作流程优先选择了四个命中化合物（C1-C4）进行实验测试。计算分析表明，所有四种化合物均保持在alpha1/alpha3 Myb朝向的沟槽内结合，但它们在预测的对c-Myb-KIX界面的影响上存在显著差异。其中，C3被预测为最强的破坏剂，而C1则被预测为稳定该复合物。DeltaDeltaGPPI分析进一步显示，C3对c-Myb-KIX界面产生了最大的去稳定效应（+4.57 kcal/mol），其次是C2（+2.30 kcal/mol）和C4（+1.40 kcal/mol），而C1则稳定了该复合物（-6.47 kcal/mol）。这些预测通过微量热泳动（MST）得到了验证。二元c-Myb-KIX相互作用显示出表观K(d)为26.71 +/- 0.54 muM，且这些化合物抑制复合物形成的IC(50)值分别为99.6 +/- 20.5 muM（C1）、54.7 +/- 22.1 muM（C2）、16.5 +/- 0.8 muM（C3）和27.2 +/- 2.7 muM（C4）。值得注意的是，C3优于参考抑制剂Naphthol AS-E磷酸盐（28.8 +/- 3.1 muM）。总体而言，这些发现将C3确定为一个有前景的先导化合物，并确立了N-芳基邻氨基苯甲酸类作为靶向c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX相互作用的可行骨架。
